gaps.sentence: It was ___ dull a lecture that people walked out.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective (+a + noun) + that… — the alternative emphatic pattern.

gaps.sentence: I couldn't reach the shelf, ___ how tall I am.
I'm not used to ___ such spicy food.
She made the cake ___, without any help at all.
gaps.explanation: 'She made it herself' — the reflexive stresses she did it alone.

gaps.sentence: He's got a ___ of stamps from every country he's visited.
gaps.explanation: Noun form: collection (a group of collected items).

gaps.sentence: We ran out ___ petrol on the motorway.
gaps.explanation: 'run out OF something' = have none left.

gaps.sentence: The garden is ___ than I expected — it's huge!
She went to university ___ study law.
